title: Missing 5-Year-Old Boy Found Buried in Massachusetts Park
description:
Five-year-old Elijah Lewis seemingly vanished from his New Hampshire home in September 2021 without a trace. His mother, Danielle Dauphinais, and her boyfriend, Joe Stapf, had a child together only a few weeks after Lewis' disappearance. When investigators found Elijah buried in a Massachusetts State park, they knew the truth of his disappearance was much more sinister. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
